issues.competing_evidence: Woudt+12 §2.17 calls it one of two new polars and reports Swift X-ray confirmation of magnetic accretion. Oliveira+17 Table 1 says polar candidate; §6.1.8 describes only probable WD Zeeman features without a field fit. Oliveira+20 groups low-state polars; Schwope+24 Table A1 compiles class Polar.
issues.why_it_matters: Confirmation level changes magnetic-CV class counts and whether the WD identification is considered secure. Later catalog labels are not independent follow-up.
issues.needed_action: Choose whether public class should read “reported polar” with a candidate qualifier, or “polar candidate” pending source-specific polarimetry/cyclotron evidence or a secure Zeeman fit.

issues.competing_evidence: Ridder+23 Table 3 reports 1.5±0.2e-12 (1–10 keV) and 2.0±0.2e-12 (0.1–10 keV), converted from 2SXPS with source-class assumptions/PIMMS. Native 2SXPS values are observed/unabsorbed 0.3–10 keV 1.772/1.780e-12; Schwope+24 gives observed eROSITA 0.2–2.3 keV 5.35489e-13.
issues.why_it_matters: Bandpass, absorption convention and model assumptions affect cross-source X-ray comparisons; these values are not interchangeable or contemporaneous.
issues.needed_action: For precision comparisons, reproduce Ridder+23 source-specific hardness-ratio decision, NH and PIMMS conversions or adopt a uniform catalog-band set; retain all current fluxes separately pending that choice.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 Table 2 gives 3563±730 G under fundamental ECM and donor-corona assumptions. Circular polarization is observed, but emission site/mechanism are not independently located; Oliveira+17 probable Zeeman features give no numerical WD field.
issues.why_it_matters: The radio-region value could be confused with a WD surface or accretion field.
issues.needed_action: Decide whether to display this conditional radio-region field in the public catalog; keep it excluded from WD surface/polar/accretion field fields.

Her 1 audit: Table lists Her 1 as AM with K-band VLA flux 48 +/-17 uJy, +100 +/-45 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.00?, distance=1030 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; no source-specific WD surface MG field, WD Teff, WD mass, or donor properties are provided. Her 1 identity remains unresolved because the source coordinate in combined_mcv_sources.csv/Barrett table (RA=244.95543, Dec=+14.88610) conflicts with a previous supplemental SDSS/Gaia association. Cas 1 audit: Table lists C-band flux 21 +/-10 uJy, -100 +/-39 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.9396 h, distance=1608 pc, and radio-inferred B=1960 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1503-2207 audit: Table lists X-band flux 29 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-14 percent circular polarization, Porb=2.2228 h, distance=392 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FR Lyn correction after rendered Table 1 check: FR Lyn has only the Semester 18A X-band row, I=28 +/-4 uJy, RR=12 +/-6, LL=38 +/-6, CP=-52 +/-17%, offset=0.13 +/-0.22 arcsec, composite S/N1=43.3. The 49 +/-29 uJy K-band row with +37 +/-57% CP belongs to VV Pup Semester 13B. FR Lyn has no radio-inferred B entry in Table 2. BM CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 43 +/-15 uJy, -100 +/-41 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4040 h, distance=419 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. Hya 1 audit: Pelisoli+24 Appendix explicitly maps Hya 1 to RX J0859.1+0537; the prior Gaia DR3 5745881603063095680 match was a different source, MM Hya. Barrett+20 reports X-band Stokes I 6±6 μJy and custom S/N 7.3, but Ridder+23 treats the point as below 3σ. Its 2.3966 h and 441 pc values are consistent with the RX J0859 literature and Gaia DR2/EDR3 distances; the 3563±730 G inference remains conditional radio-plasma field, not WD surface field. V388 Peg audit: Table lists X-band flux 34 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-12 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3751 h, distance=689 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FL Cet audit: Table lists X-band flux 11 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-53 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4523 h, distance=319 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-pole field measured from cyclotron harmonics by Schmidt+05_FLCet. LW Cam audit: Table lists X-band flux 50 +/-4 uJy, -100 +/-9 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.6211 h, distance=542 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; Section 4.2 identifies a narrow ~10.295 GHz feature and derives ~3.6 kG for the radio plasma while adopting/citing Bwd~20 MG from Ferrario+15/Tovmassian+01_LWCam. The kG value is not the WD surface field. ST LMi audit: Table lists X-band flux 153 +/-12 uJy, circular polarization entry near -100 +/-20 percent in the OCR/local text, Porb=1.8981 h, distance=113 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. V603 Aql audit: Table lists C-band 22 +/-3 uJy and X-band 32 +/-7 uJy with high circular-polarization fractions and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; Section 4.2 notes the system was included because RKcat had possible-IP context, but later work associates the photometric period with superhump/disk precession. Barrett+20 argue any WD field must be weak (<1 kG) or it would truncate the disk, so the kG radio value is not a WD surface field. MQ Dra audit: Table lists X-band flux 17 +/-4 uJy with +100 +/-34 percent circular polarization, Porb=4.3912 h, distance=186 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-region field. AP CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 24 +/-4 uJy with weak circular polarization (-5 +/-22 percent), Porb=2.5310 h, distance=209 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table. V1007 Her audit: Table lists X-band flux 38 +/-9 uJy with +100 +/-29 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.9988 h, distance=462 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/cyclotron field measured by Greiner+98_V1007Her. V1323 Her audit: Table lists C-band flux 43 +/-9 uJy with +100 +/-20 percent circular polarization, Porb=4.4016 h, distance=2244 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface/accretion-region MG field. AM Her audit: Table lists C-band flux 88 +/-5 uJy, plus additional X/K-band detections summarized elsewhere in the paper; Table 2 gives Porb=3.0942 h, distance=88 pc, and no radio-inferred B value for AM Her. V1432 Aql audit: Table lists X-band flux 15 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-47 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3656 h, distance=462 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1955+0045 audit: Table lists X-band flux 79 +/-5 uJy with circular polarization -2 +/-6 percent, Porb=1.3932 h, distance=171 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table. QQ Vul audit: Table lists K-band flux 92 +/-39 uJy with -100 +/-60 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.7084 h, distance=317 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface/accretion-region MG field. AE Aqr audit: Table lists C-, X-, and K-band detections 5123 +/-9, 5497 +/-11, and 8031 +/-34 uJy with circular polarization 0 +/-1 percent; Table 2 lists Porb=9.8797 h, distance=91 pc, radio flux 8031 uJy, and radio luminosity 1628 (table units), with no radio-inferred B value for AE Aqr. HU Aqr audit: Table 1/2 lists X-band radio flux 44 +/-13 uJy with circular polarization -60 +/-23 percent, Porb=2.0836 h, distance about 192 pc, and no radio-inferred B value; no component masses, Teff, or WD surface field are provided. EQ Cet audit: Table 1 K-band Stokes-I flux 96 +/- 30 microJy and circular polarization +100 +/- 70%; Table 2 7530 +/- 365 G assumes fundamental ECM from donor corona; field uncertainty is based on central frequency/bandwidth, not a WD-surface field measurement. BS Tri: Table 1 gives VLA X band 7.964–10.012 GHz, Stokes I 57±9 μJy, RR 49±16 μJy, LL 0±15 μJy and circular polarization +100±45%; semester 2015A, exact date/state unstated. Table 2 field 3210±365 G is conditional on fundamental ECM and is radio-plasma/donor-coronal context, not WD field. The generic Ridder+23 exclusion of some sub-3σ Barrett detections does not apply to BS Tri (I/σ≈6.3). UZ For: Table 1 reports C-band 78±9 μJy, RR=0±25, LL=85±26 and circular polarization −100±42%; exact date/state not specified. Table 2 radio field 1960±365 G assumes fundamental electron-cyclotron maser radiation from a donor corona and is not the WD field. Tau 4: Table 1 2015A X-band Stokes I=105±32 μJy, RR=0±72, LL=150±74, CP=−100±69%; Table 2 legacy 1.50? h is superseded by K2 and 3210±365 G is conditional fundamental-ECM radio plasma, not WD field.; WX LMi audit: Table 1 reports 2015A VLA C-band Stokes I=73±12 μJy, RR=49±17, LL=26±19, CP=+31±34%; X-band I=52±14 μJy, RR=33±17, LL=48±17, CP=−19±30%. V1043 Cen Table 1: semester 18A X-band Stokes I=20±5, RR=0±7, LL=20±8 microJy, CP=−100±53%, centroid offset=0.16±0.60 arcsec, custom total S/N=11.2. Table 2 B=3563±730 G assumes donor-coronal fundamental ECM and is not a WD surface field.; AM Her Table 1 C/X/K band Stokes I, RR, LL and CP values and Table 2 Porb=3.0942 h checked.
